{{Top}}
'''Sennari''' was a lethal, fast-acting [[Poison/Legends|toxin]] often used by members of the [[Assassin's Guild/Legends|Assassin's Guild]]. Toxins of this type were usually delivered via [[Poison dart/Legends|poison dart]], offering the advantage of a silent kill and near-instantaneous results.

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jodo Kast]], in particular, was known to use this particular toxin, firing poison darts from launchers integrated into his [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="TM">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref>

[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] used Sennari to kill [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]].<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
